create_vision_transformer_head: create a VisionTransformerHead with a specified input plane size and number of output classes
create_head_with_hidden_layer: create a VisionTransformerHead with a hidden layer using hidden_dim and Tanh activation
create_head_with_l2_normalization: create a VisionTransformerHead that applies L2 normalization to inputs before the forward pass
init_head_weights: initialize the VisionTransformerHead weights using Lecun normal init for pre_logits and zeros for head
build_head_from_config: build a VisionTransformerHead instance from a config dictionary using the from_config class method
